descriptionHtml:
Bug B01 · P0 · new

Photo census scan never finds anyone: the vision model wraps its JSON in a ```json block and parseModelJson (convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98) silently returns nothing (Hospital and Nursing Home)

Tickets: TFA-94425 ready for qa; TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-92587 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Also blocks dev U77; U78–U81 paused for the same reason Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92587): it also blocks every Nursing Home scan case on dev (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S08, S17, S18; dev units U77–U81 paused).

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S18, TC-09/S04, TC-09/S06, TC-09/S08, TC-09/S17, TC-09/S18

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S07 Rows the physician deselects on the scan sheet → outcome

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)
  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. … (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-02 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 3)
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 2; TFA-92587 How it works 2; TFA-92587 How it works 6)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given QA Oak (Cedar 1, In Today), QA Pine (Cedar 2, In Today) and QA Poplar (Cedar 3, not In Today) in All Residents, plus the fixture resident (In Today, MRN 'QA-<tag>-10'); no date of birth anywhere (D5)

When Scan a photo of Oak, Pine, Poplar and a new resident Sorrel → untick the rows of Oak, Poplar and Sorrel, keep Pine → confirm → Today's Visits → All Residents

Then Known + In Today + selected (Pine): stays on today. Known + In Today + deselected (Oak): stays on Today's Visits, or the app says before the write that Oak will leave today (Q1); never removed without a word. Known + not In Today + deselected (Poplar): stays off today and unchanged in All Residents. New + deselected (Sorrel): not created

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: s07-sheet-deselected shows 'Add 1 to Today's Visits' (the three unticks registered); s07-today has QA Oak and QA Pine, not QA Poplar, and mustNotContain 'In Today ✓' (U2 'adds', AC 3 'never silently dropping'); s07-all has Oak, Pine, Poplar and 'In Today ✓' and not QA Sorrel (U3, U5). …

Where it ran: dev unit U80; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
